cover.prompt: Inside the Tholos of Schedia: liskovia in a saffron yellow himation sits at the wooden desk on the round stone podium beside a board on its post; two young tholos-runner set off across the stone floor carrying wax tablets; through the open porch doorway beyond, the bay and the distant Chamber are visible in morning light.
cover.others: four more council members sitting well apart on stone benches against the circular wall, each with a tablet stand.

r.prompt: a group of three students walk out of the far gate and a group of three students walk out of the near gate. at the altar the priestess is counseling another group of three students.

g1.prompt: Before the grand circular portico of the Tholos of Schedia, council leader liskovia in a saffron yellow himation stands on the marble threshold, holding an inscribed decree tablet extended forward from her chest in an authoritative pose; tholos-runner in a brown tunic is frozen in an explosive, wide contact running stride as he receives the tablet, elbows flared outward and arms swung clear of his body; a monolithic Doric column of the outer Tholos peristyle forms the foreground anchor on the left margin; the curving marble entablature and Schedia hillside terraces drop diagonally into the bay, sharply defined under directional sunlight with pristine sky above.
g1.others: okios and kleon conferring by the Tholos bronze entrance.

o01-court.prompt: On the paved court before the Tholos, okios in blue-grey, liskovia in saffron, and kleon in green walk towards the gabled porch from different sides, while melissa in madder red descends the porch steps, walking away alone; nobody speaks.
o01-court.others: two young runners in short tunics crossing the court in the distance.

o02-podium.prompt: Close on the round podium in the Tholos: liskovia in saffron sits at the wooden desk writing on a wax tablet with a stylus, the painted board on its post beside her; two young tholos-runner take wax tablets from the desk and set off down the steps in different directions towards the benches.
o02-podium.others: two council members seated at benches along the wall in the soft background.

o03-caller.prompt: At his stone bench against the Tholos wall, kleon in green sits writing invitations on small wax tablets, a new blank board propped against the bench beside him; two young tholos-runner wait beside the bench to take them; across the floor the round podium stands empty, its desk bare.
o03-caller.others: another council member seated far away at a bench across the drum.

o04-porch.prompt: Two scenes at once, split by the porch doorway: outside on the shaded porch in the foreground okios in blue-grey stands at a small table handing a wax tablet to a young tholos-runner; inside through the open doorway, lit by morning light from the lantern, liskovia in saffron sits at the podium's desk with a board on its post.

o05-bench.prompt: Close on a curved stone bench against the honey limestone wall of the Tholos: theron in grey sits on the bench with a wax tablet open on his knees, running a finger over the smoothed, blank bare wax; the Greek name ΘΗΡΩΝ is carved into the edge of the stone seat, and a neat stack of tablets rests on the small stone stand beside it.

cover-alt.prompt: On the paved terrace round the Tholos of Schedia: tholos-runner runs out of the porch carrying a wax tablet; liskovia and kleon walk side by side across the paving toward the porch; scholar, a citizen with a petition scroll in his hand, steps onto the terrace from the path and heads for the door.
